integrity: A complete all-parameter proof is supplied. Two embedded Python 3 programs provide finite corroboration and captured outputs. No independent audit or external certification has been performed.
limitations: Only initially primitive period-three chip-firing configurations on loopless complete graphs with at least three vertices are counted. No assertion about transient basins or other primitive periods. Earlier unindexed coverage cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact primitive-three chip-firing energy bands on complete graphs
